description: Seller-side check that an Allowance vault receipt on NEAR paid a given account at least a given amount, bound to the seller request hash, at final finality. Returns valid or the reason (not paid yet, wrong payee, amount, asset or request, unknown receipt, not a vault) and the vault code hash read at the same block. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

ft.description: NEAR account id, e.g. alice.near or a 64-hex implicit account

minAmount.description: minimum amount in base units: yoctoNEAR, or the token smallest unit when asset is an ft

network.description: NEAR network; default: testnet for *.testnet accounts, mainnet otherwise

nonce.description: alternative to requestHash: the nonce the seller issued; the hash is computed server-side

payee.description: the account that must have been paid (usually the seller itself)

receiptId.description: receipt id returned by the vault pay call

requestHash.description: base64(sha256(utf8(nonce))): the 32-byte request hash the receipt must carry

vault.description: Allowance vault account that issued the receipt

name: verify_allowance_receipt
title: Allowance receipt verification (NEAR)
